why: Doc sentence verbatim: YES, line 166 of llm-gateway-protocol.md; the rest of the line does not reverse it. Cited line accurate: YES, packages/shared/src/agent/backend/internal/drivers/anthropic.ts:76 is `.filter(m => m.id.startsWith('claude-') && !m.id.startsWith('claude-2') && !m.id.startsWith('claude-instant') && !m.id.startsWith('claude-1'))`. The CONSEQUENCE is false, and it is the inert-worklist section 4 shape #3/#4 (enforcement one layer up + wrong sibling subsystem named). (1) Wrong subsystem. The doc's section is Claude Code CLI's opt-in gateway model discovery: `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1`, off by default, `GET /v1/models?limit=1000`, 3s timeout, redirects treated as failure, cached to `~/.claude/cache/gateway-models.json`, feeding the CLI's `/model` picker. That feature does not exist in the fork at all -- `grep -ran GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY` over the repo returns one docs line and zero code. `anthropicDriver.fetchModels` is a different mechanism: Nessy's own catalog refresh for the app's model list, always on, paginated `limit=100` + `after_id`, no 3s timeout, no redirect ban, no gateway-models.json cache. (2) The claimed failure path is unreachable. A `providerType: 'anthropic'` connection never carries a gateway baseUrl by construction: `createBuiltInConnection('anthropic-api', baseUrl)` returns `pi_compat` (server-core/src/domain/connection-setup-logic.ts:142), pinned by two tests (apps/electron/src/main/__tests__/connection-setup-logic.test.ts:83-88 and server-core/src/domain/connection-setup-logic.test.ts:165); the SETUP handler flips an existing anthropic api_key connection to `pi_compat` + `customEndpoint: {api:'anthropic-messages'}` the moment a baseUrl is set and back to `anthropic` when it is cleared (server-core/src/handlers/rpc/llm-connections.ts:78-89); and `resolveSetupTestConnectionHint` returns `pi_compat` whenever a baseUrl is present (shared/src/agent/backend/factory.ts:415). So every gateway connection routes to `piDriver.fetchModels` (drivers/pi.ts:311-333), which never calls `/v1/models` and applies no `claude-` prefix filter. (3) The picker does not come back empty: the setup UI REQUIRES a declared model list for a custom endpoint -- 'Default model is required for custom endpoints.' (apps/electron/src/renderer/components/apisetup/ApiKeyInput.tsx:441-445) -- and the pi_compat picker is populated from those user-declared models. (4) The fork is not blind to the namespaced ids the claim cites: `isClaudeModel` (shared/src/config/models.ts:345-347) matches `anthropic/claude-...` (OpenRouter/LiteLLM) and `anthropic.claude-...` (Bedrock) explicitly, and `isBareBedrockClaudeModel` (shared/src/config/models-pi.ts:98) handles the Bedrock form on the Pi path. Both namespaces are handled -- just in the sibling subsystem the finding named wrongly. (5) The routing is a recorded product decision, not an oversight: root AGENTS.md ('the `anthropic-api` template upgrades to `pi_compat` once a custom endpoint is present') and packages/shared/AGENTS.md ('Prefer routing new model vendors through the existing Pi path'). Not one of the nine section 3 owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md -- those are the seatbelt wildcard, availableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath, and listSessionSummaries.
correctedState: anthropic.ts:76 does filter on `startsWith('claude-')` with no `anthropic` branch, but that filter governs Nessy's own Anthropic-DIRECT catalog refresh, not gateway discovery, and it can never see a gateway's model list. A base URL flips an Anthropic API-key connection to `providerType: 'pi_compat'` at creation (connection-setup-logic.ts:142), at save (rpc/llm-connections.ts:78-89) and at setup-test (factory.ts:415), so gateway model lists are served by piDriver.fetchModels from user-declared models, never by this filter -- the picker is not empty. Namespaced Claude ids are recognised elsewhere: models.ts:345-347 matches `anthropic/claude-*` and `anthropic.claude-*`, models-pi.ts:98 handles the Bedrock form. The fork implements no counterpart to the documented CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY feature (zero code hits), which the doc itself says is off by default. Residual, inert: the SETUP handler deliberately skips the providerType mutation for OAuth connections (rpc/llm-connections.ts:77-78), so an anthropic OAuth connection carrying a baseUrl would reach this filter -- but Claude Max OAuth against a third-party gateway is not a supported configuration here and sits behind the off-by-default NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE. If the prefix is ever widened, do it for doc-shape fidelity, not to fix a reachable empty picker.
